articles.title: How to sign in
steps: Open TIDONG and choose the available Sign In option.
Enter the credentials of your authorized account.
Select Sign In and follow any verification shown on screen.
After login, open the dashboard available to your account.
articles.when_unavailable: If you cannot sign in, use the official support or account-recovery option shown on the site. Do not share your password or verification codes in chat.

articles.title: Open your Delivery Partner Dashboard
steps: Sign in with your approved Delivery Partner account.
Open Delivery Partner Dashboard.
Your assigned deliveries appear there with their current statuses.
If no delivery is assigned, the dashboard will display an empty-list message.
articles.when_unavailable: If the dashboard is unavailable or Delivery is disabled, contact your firm for operational questions; website support can assist with technical access only.

articles.title: Set your availability
steps: Sign in and open Delivery Partner Dashboard.
Find Availability near the top of the dashboard.
Choose Go Online or Go Offline, whichever is currently offered.
Check the displayed availability state after submitting.
articles.when_unavailable: When the option is unavailable or your account is not approved, contact the responsible firm.

articles.title: Accept and pick up a delivery
questions: डिलीवरी स्वीकार और पिकअप कैसे करें?
steps: Open an assigned delivery on Delivery Partner Dashboard.
For a new assignment, choose Accept or Decline as appropriate.
After accepting and physically collecting the parcel, choose Mark Picked Up.
Review the updated delivery status.
articles.when_unavailable: Buttons appear according to the delivery's state. Ask the firm to resolve an assignment issue.

articles.title: Mark a delivery as delivered
steps: Open the delivery after its status is Picked Up.
Confirm that the parcel has actually been handed to the recipient.
Ask the recipient for the verification PIN and enter it only in the website's designated field; do not paste it into AI chat.
Enter the recipient's name in Received by (name).
Choose Mark Delivered and check the result shown by the website.
articles.when_unavailable: If PIN verification fails or the button is not present, do not bypass the check; contact the responsible firm for assistance.

articles.title: Report an unsuccessful delivery
questions: How do I report failed delivery?
डिलीवरी फेल होने पर क्या करें?
steps: Open the relevant delivery in Picked Up status.
Enter the actual issue in Failure reason.
Choose Report Failed.
Follow your firm's instructions for safe physical return if the parcel remains with you.
articles.when_unavailable: Only the authorized firm can confirm a received return or decide the next dispatch action.

articles.title: Invite a Delivery Partner
questions: How to invite a delivery partner?
steps: Open Business Delivery Management with your authorized firm account.
Find Invite Existing Authorized Partner Account.
Choose the business, enter the existing authorized account email and select vehicle type.
Choose Invite Partner.
Review the invitation status in Business Partner Verification & Approval.
articles.when_unavailable: Public self-registration is not part of this candidate flow. If the option is missing, request firm authorization or technical help as appropriate.

articles.title: Screen and approve a partner for your firm
steps: Open Business Delivery Management.
Find Business Partner Verification & Approval.
Complete the firm's required screening outside the assistant.
Only after screening, use the Screening completed confirmation and Attest.
Use Approve for Firm when it is offered. The same section also provides Suspend for Firm.
articles.when_unavailable: Approvals are firm decisions. Website administrators and support staff do not approve for a vendor.

articles.title: Assign a delivery to a partner
steps: Open Business Delivery Management and find Assign Delivery.
Select your authorized Business, matching Branch and Approved Available Partner.
Fill in the delivery's required recipient and destination details directly in the secure website form; never send them in AI chat.
Review any delivery fee or earning fields shown on the website; these are snapshots, not a payout confirmation.
Select Assign Delivery and privately share any one-time recipient PIN only with the recipient using the approved method.
articles.when_unavailable: If the form or partner is unavailable, check that your firm has enabled the workflow and that the partner is available. This assistant cannot dispatch on your behalf.

articles.title: Confirm a physical return
steps: Open Authorized Business Deliveries.
Locate the failed delivery in your authorized business.
Only after physically receiving the parcel, tick Physical return received.
Choose Confirm Return and review the updated record.
articles.when_unavailable: Do not confirm a return that has not physically occurred. Firm staff handle reassignments and cancellations under their permissions.

articles.title: Turn an available website module on or off
questions: मॉड्यूल चालू या बंद कैसे करें?
steps: Sign in with an account authorized for Module Management.
Open Module Management and find Installed Modules.
Locate the module that is already deployed and registered.
Use Turn ON or Turn OFF if the control appears for your account.
Check the updated status. Turning ON does not install code or grant anyone firm operations.
articles.when_unavailable: If the button is not visible, request a platform-authorized permission review. A module not installed must pass developer review before registration.

articles.title: Turn an available website feature on or off
questions: How to switch a website option off?
वेबसाइट फीचर कैसे ऑन ऑफ करें?
steps: Open Module Management with an authorized platform account.
Find Website Feature Availability.
Locate the reviewed feature.
Choose Turn ON or Turn OFF if permitted.
Check the status; a feature remains unavailable when its parent module is off.
articles.when_unavailable: Feature availability is a technical switch and does not give website staff vendor business-operation rights.

articles.title: Use optional voice help
steps: On a page where Voice Helper is enabled, choose the microphone or text command option.
Allow microphone permission only if you want voice recognition, then speak a supported navigation command.
Use text commands when the browser does not support speech recognition.
Use the mute control to keep notification sounds off, or enable them explicitly if wanted.
articles.when_unavailable: This is a browser helper, not a full conversational AI. It does not submit order, payment, approval or delivery status changes.
